# Python dependencies for bob-qse-remediation 1.0.0
#
# remediation_tool.py (.bob/skills/qse-remediation/) was analyzed and imports only
# Python standard-library modules: argparse, datetime, difflib, glob, hashlib,
# json, os, re, subprocess, sys.
# There are NO third-party packages to install, so this file intentionally lists none.
#
# Python: 3.11 or later (the script itself runs on 3.7+, but older releases are end-of-life).
#
# External (non-pip) tools required by the skills:
#   - IBM Quantum Safe Explorer CLI (licensed; see <QSE_CLI_DIR> in README.md)
#   - git   (remediation_tool.py records the repository HEAD; repositoryUrl lookup)
#   - jq    (validates repositoryUrl in the findings JSON)
#
# Install (inside the activated virtual environment):
#   python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
